name: GymWen
tagline: Official App for the Gymnasium Wendelstein
blurb: Official app for the Gymnasium Wendelstein.
description:
Official app for the Gymnasium Wendelstein.

With this app pupils are able to:
* check their teachers substitutions
* search through the teachers list
* book food in the local cafeteria
* use mebis
* and much more

For more information about the Developer you can visit this site.
